813-5744-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
813-5744-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2023-4770-6006-7730.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1420-2178-8095.easyPrerequisites:
Godsire doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Godsire.
1420-2178-8095.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Godsire triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Godsire.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

645-728-1267-5361.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-728-1267-5361.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

1838-3652-3661-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1838-3652-3661-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1619-2438-4605-5542-6147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6147.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rilsa Rael from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Rilsa Rael.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Rilsa Rael token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Rilsa Rael trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6147.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1395-5078-7729.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

2099-2866-4708-4986.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

4359-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1-2498-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1-2498-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
1-2498-6282.description:
Proceed to your next cleanup step, causing you to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Containment Construct triggers for each card discarded this way. Resolve the first trigger, exiling the discarded card.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve all remaining Containment Construct abilities, if applicable, choosing not to exile anything.
Once the stack has emptied and all players pass priority, you will still be in the cleanup step and thus need to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Repeat from step 2.

2577-5670-6484.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-6484.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Wayward Servant triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

465-803-2079-3742-4251.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-803-2079-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2099-4493-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
You have enough mana to cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication
2099-4493-5365.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat from step 2.
2099-4493-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

710-1052-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Danitha's power.
Repeat.

3000-3330-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-3330-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

276-1633-2060-4120-5032.description:
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Cast Hanabi Blast either from your hand or from the top of your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

2585-3263-3525-4785.description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Dynaheir by tapping it, copying the next ability that you activate that costs at least four mana this turn.
Activate Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {4}.
Dynaheir triggers, copying of Grim Monolith's ability.
Resolve the copy of Grim Monolith's ability, untapping it.
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {3}.
Resolve Grim Monolith's ability from step 4, untapping it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Dynaheir.
Repeat.

3750-4221.notablePrerequisites: Lands and creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
3750-4221.description:
Animate lands you control using Living Plane.
Activate all mana producing lands and creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat and main phase after this phase.
Repeat from step 2.
